long_description:
Get ready to dance and sweat with Priya’s fun and energetic Bollycardio workout session!

About this Event

Bollycardio with PriyaGet ready to sweat and smile at Bollycardio with Priya! This fun, high-energy workout combines heart-pumping Bollywood dance moves with cardio exercises that will leave you feeling amazing. Perfect for all fitness levels, it's an awesome way to boost your mood and get moving. Join us in person and dance your way to a fitter, happier you. Don't miss out on the fun—Priya's got the beats and moves to keep you grooving! Burn calories before gaining calories for Thanksgiving. 

About the instructor:
Priya Iyer is a versatile and seasoned LA-based dancer with almost 20 years of experience in various dance styles, including ballet, tap, jazz, modern, gymnastics/flexibility, Bharatnatyam, musical theatre, Bollywood, Indo-contemporary, semi-classical, and Indian fusion. Her undergraduate training included a focus in musical theatre, and her degree reflects a dance minor. She has performed in most of her trained forms in recitals, theatrical shows, stage performances, TV appearances, and dedicated dance videos. She also has experience teaching the noted South Asian dance forms. Noteworthy credits and companies include Doonya (NYC, instructor), Ithaca College Theatre Arts (NY), Hypokrit Theatre Company (NYC), Sanskruti Dance (NJ), Junoon Performing Arts (NYC), Tamasha (NYC), Dance Drama Dramatics (NYC), and Adaa Dance Project (USA).
